item.lead: The script needs the whole corpus as text before it can do anything else. It does not download it every time. Look at how the file path is built, then at the single `if` that decides whether to fetch.
item.follow: Line 13 puts the text file in the same folder as the script, whatever folder you run it from. Line 14 asks whether that file exists. On the first run it doesn't, so lines 15–17 request the text and write it to that path. On a second run the file is already there, so the check is false and the request is skipped. The saved text is reused. Next, the script finds which distinct characters that text holds.

cards.label: Download only if file is missing
